Natural Earth basemaps cached for the current R session

Source: R/plot_cartography.R
gtropic_basemap.Rd

Countries use the locally installed Natural Earth data package. First use of an administrative-level-1 layer requires the optional, non-CRAN rnaturalearthhires package. No layer is downloaded by this function.

Usage

gtropic_basemap(scale = "medium", what = c("countries", "admin1", "none"))

Arguments

scale

Country resolution: "small" (110) or "medium" (50). Large (10) country layers are deliberately unsupported. Ignored for admin1, which uses the resolution supplied by rnaturalearth::ne_states().

what

One of "countries", "admin1", or "none".

Value

An sf object, or NULL for what = "none". Layers are cached by resolution and type until the R session ends.

Examples

# \donttest{
gtropic_basemap(what = "none")
#> NULL
if (requireNamespace("rnaturalearth", quietly = TRUE) &&
  requireNamespace("rnaturalearthdata", quietly = TRUE)) {
  gtropic_basemap()
}
